stages.name: Dev-kit bench
stages.gate: measured average current <= 20 uA with the chosen advertising (1285 ms) and 10 rings/month (power.md M1-M9); ring >= 75 dB(A) at 25 cm in 3x on a fresh cell
stages.detail: CC2340 LaunchPad + PPK2 power profiler, PAM8904 + piezo on a breadboard

stages.name: Works-like / looks-like
stages.gate: printed enclosure closes on the real stack (10.0 mm limit); bayonet turns >= 90 deg with a coin; IPX7 pre-test in a bucket passes
stages.detail: printed shell and lid, real holder, cell and membranes

stages.name: EVT-0 build and bring-up
stages.evidence: estimate: JLCPCB PCBA build >= 4 days (verified) + shipping + bring-up
stages.gate: all rails up, BLE link at 10 m, current within 20 % of the bench, antenna matched in the printed shell
stages.detail: 10 units at JLCPCB; bring-up; VNA antenna match

stages.name: EVT-1 revision + pre-scan
stages.gate: pre-scan passes FCC 15.247 / EN 300 328 margins; ESD +/-8 kV contact on the button and lid; engineering freeze

stages.name: Tooling T1
stages.evidence: estimate: aluminum 3-4 weeks (Formlabs) to pilot runs 6-8 weeks (Hubs) [verified ranges 2026-11-08]
stages.gate: T1 parts within drawing tolerances; bayonet torque and O-ring compression measured; cosmetic spec agreed for three colors
stages.detail: aluminum shell + lid tools, membrane mold

stages.name: DVT build (100 units)
stages.gate: IP67, 1.5 m drop (26 drops), -10 C ring, button life, UL 4200A pre-check passed; 12-month life confirmed from measured current

stages.name: US certification
stages.gate: FCC grant, UL 4200A test report, IP67 report, Bluetooth listing
stages.detail: FCC 15C/15B, UL 4200A report, IP67, Bluetooth SIG listing

stages.name: PVT line validation
stages.gate: fixtures validated; first-pass yield >= 95 %; packaging with coin-cell warnings approved

stages.name: EU/UK/BR certification
stages.evidence: estimate (compliance.md): formal tests 4-8 weeks, then Anatel 4-10 weeks after the reports
stages.gate: EU DoC with reports, UK DoC, Anatel certificate
